dataset.title: Input data definition, species table and run configurations for: Optimizing Spectrogram Front-Ends and Training Strategies for Deep Learning-Based Acoustic Insect Classification

creator.organizationName: ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences, Institute of Computational Life Sciences

abstract.para: Metadata defining the input data and training runs of the study "Optimizing Spectrogram Front-Ends and Training Strategies for Deep Learning-Based Acoustic Insect Classification". The study trains EfficientNetV2-S classifiers on insect sound recordings of 451 species of Orthoptera and Cicadidae from InsectSet459 version 1.0.

The audio is not redistributed. The release lists every InsectSet459 recording used (24,950) and not used (1,347, with the reason), with split, species, original sample rate, file size, CRC-32 checksum, licence, contributor and source links; a table linking the 451 species to Catalogue of Life, GBIF and ITIS identifiers; and the settings of all 112 training runs of the front-end study and the training-strategy sweep, relative to the published baseline configuration.

intellectualRights.para: The metadata in this release are licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence (CC BY 4.0). The audio recordings are not part of this release; each keeps the licence given in the license column of files_used.csv and files_excluded.csv.

geographicCoverage.geographicDescription: Global: recordings from many countries, as collected in InsectSet459 from xeno-canto, iNaturalist and BioAcoustica.

taxonomicCoverage.generalTaxonomicCoverage: 451 species of Orthoptera and Cicadidae (Hemiptera). Classification and identifiers from the Catalogue of Life Checklist COL24.4 (doi:10.48580/dg4lg); for the 2 species absent from COL24.4, from the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy.

contact.organizationName: ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences, Institute of Computational Life Sciences

section.title: Source data
section.para: All recordings come from InsectSet459 version 1.0 (Faiß and Stowell, 2025; doi:10.5281/zenodo.15675220), which pools research-grade recordings of Orthoptera and Cicadidae from xeno-canto, iNaturalist and BioAcoustica and provides an official train/validation/test split.

section.title: Selection of recordings
section.para: Recordings with a sample rate below 44.1 kHz were excluded (1,284 files), because the 0.4-22 kHz band analysed by the models would not be fully represented. Species with fewer than 3 training, 2 validation or 1 test recordings after this filter were then removed (8 species, 63 files). The remaining 24,950 recordings of 451 species were used, in the official split. Every recording was checked against the InsectSet459 annotation file and zip archives; file size and CRC-32 checksum are those stored in the zip archives.

section.title: Taxonomy
section.para: Species names were matched to the Catalogue of Life Checklist release COL24.4 (doi:10.48580/dg4lg), the release used by InsectSet459, to the GBIF Backbone Taxonomy and to ITIS (queried 2026-10-08).

section.title: Run configurations
section.para: The settings of each training run were taken from the configuration logged for that run, after command-line overrides. Each row of run_configurations.csv, applied to the published baseline configuration, reproduces the logged configuration.
